tool_input.description: Inspect casts and imports in KoBoToolbox files

result:
I removed the `as` casts from the new code. I did not run tests, lint, typecheck, or the app, as you asked.

- **`KoBoToolbox.node.ts`**: The `setValidationMany` branch no longer casts `submissionIds` or `validationStatus`. The status is now wrapped in lodash `toString(...)`, which the file already uses elsewhere. I added that import at the top of the file.
- **`GenericFunctions.ts`**: `parseSubmissionIds` takes `value: unknown` instead of `value: string`. Its body already passes the value through `toString`, so no cast or guard was needed.
- **`SubmissionDescription.ts`**: I also fixed the indentation of the new "Update Validation Status for Many" option. Its braces were misaligned by one level in the diff. This changes no behavior.

The existing `as` casts elsewhere in these files were already there before this change, so I left them alone.

One thing I did not change: the new `catch (error)` block uses `error.message`. If the repo's TypeScript config uses unknown catch variables, that line will fail typecheck. I did not verify this because you asked me not to run the typecheck.
